name: Lu Bu
subtitle: Flying General
description: Raise Barriers and charge through enemies causing Despair and Havoc!
lore: Lu Bu is a skilled warrior, but also a habitual traitor without loyalty. He considers the near paralysis of Tian’s bureaucracy a sign of weakness, and searches for someone to whom he can betray Tian’s gods in exchange for power and authority. He has recently approached Ninurta in Ekur—a visit that has allowed Lillith to ensnare Lu Bu in her schemes.

skills.name: Battle Hardened
skills.description: When this hero has [mechanic:barrier], inflict 20% increased damage and reduce the damage received by 20%.

skills.name: Battle Cry
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (15%HP+120%ATK). If this hero has [mechanic:barrier], has 50% chance to place [mechanic:despair] on the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Impenetrable Fury
skills.description: Attack all enemies (13%HP+110%ATK) with a 80% chance to place [mechanic:blunt-i] for 2 turns. If the hero is under [mechanic:barrier] the attack is always Strong.
